csv_project_name: Consultant Darke County Building Department Plans Examiner
csv_scope_of_work: The Darke County Board of Commissioners are requesting Statements of Qualifications for the provision of professional architectural/engineering (A/E) services necessary to serve as the Plans Examiner or Back-Up Plans Examiner for the Darke County Building Department. The Plans Examiner shall provide services as required for plan review and permit issuance of commercial building repairs, renovations, and new construction as required by the State Board of Building Standards pursuant to the OAC.

title: Consultant Darke County Building Department Plans Examiner
short_description: County seeks A/E plans examiner services for commercial building permit reviews.
project_scope: Provision of professional architectural and engineering services to act as Plans Examiner or Back-Up Plans Examiner for the Darke County Building Department. No specific building, size, span, gross floor area, or construction program is identified.
services: Plans examiner services; architectural services; civil engineering; inspection services; electrical engineering; mechanical engineering; structural engineering; review of commercial building plans and support for permit issuance.
